authority: owner instructed 'ja bitte setzte fort' on the proposed E08-T04; design decisions by the agent, the budget needs a separate owner approval (configs/experiments/X3_approval.json)
trigger: E08-T04 (second sensor family, combined shift) and the deferred rho .1 sensitivity (amendment 01, O5)
test_data_seen: X1/X2 results on positions 0-79 are known and motivated no change to methods, configurations or estimands; positions 80-139 of both lists have never been run

decisions.B1 scope: All selected X1/X2 configurations are reused unchanged; nothing is tuned on these buildings. Only the four correlated cells run, because the shift touches only the shared error.
decisions.B2 buildings: Positions 80-139 of id_test and ood_test, never run before. The replacement rule of amendment 01 (O2) and A1 apply.
decisions.B3 Gaussian field: src/argus/sensors/ood_field.py: 32 random Fourier features, length 2.0 m, time constant 1 / rate_sum = 20 s, P(g = 1) = rho = .05 exactly, private error matched to e = .14. Agents keep the cell model, so this condition is a documented model misspecification.
decisions.B4 rho .1: Cell field with rho .1 and q .05, model-matched: the sensitivity deferred by amendment 01, O5.
decisions.B5 reference: ref_id and ref_ood repeat the preregistered cell sensor on the same fresh buildings, so a shift effect is a paired difference on identical buildings.
decisions.B6 estimands: Per condition, on the four cells with equal weights and families 50/50 (OOD also per family): mean loss, coverage, bytes, gain and coverage loss of the candidate against the control and against every other control, gain per cell. Per shift: difference of gain and of loss against its reference, same bootstrap draws.
decisions.B7 status: Descriptive only: intervals, no p-values, no H2 decision and no new claim. H2 stays decided by X1/X2. A reversal of the sign of the gain or a result against the mechanism is reported as a finding.
decisions.B8 inference: Paired cluster bootstrap over buildings, stratified by family, 10 000 draws, seed 20261103.
decisions.B9 stop: A budget stop evaluates the largest even position prefix complete in both lists; below 40 the batch is inconclusive and is never topped up. tools/analyze_x3.py is frozen by hash in configs/experiments/X3_frozen.json and runs once.
